claims.claim_text: The piece rejects flagships for rugged tools (title framing).
claims.evidence_quote: rejecting trends and seeking solutions ... rugged, reliable phone

claims.claim_text: Early phones: reliable Sony Ericsson, a phoneless spell, then a day-one Motorola Droid.
claims.evidence_quote: My first cellphone was a Sony Ericsson J100 ... For a while, I didn't even own a phone ... I bought it [Motorola Droid] on day one

claims.claim_text: The Motorola Droid quickly became the centerpiece of his life.
claims.evidence_quote: it quickly became a centerpiece of my life
claims.reasoning: Direct quote-level match.

claims.claim_text: Smartphone disillusionment turned him into a consumer, so he retreated to a dial-pad phone.
claims.evidence_quote: made me feel more like a consumer than a user. So, I made a drastic decision: I switched to a dial-pad phone

claims.claim_text: Notifications and attention-stealing apps created problems instead of solving them.
claims.evidence_quote: They weren't solving problems for me; they were creating new ones. Notifications ... attention-stealing apps

claims.claim_text: Screens, keyboards, styluses, and watches all failed the same way.
claims.evidence_quote: Small screens and large screens, Physical keyboards, Stylus-equipped phones, smartwatches ... the result was the same

claims.evidence_quote: built to sell features I didn't need, push ads I didn't want, and lock me into ecosystems I avoided

claims.claim_text: Requirements were battery, ruggedness, SD, jack, and mic; cameras, AI, and cloud were rejected.
claims.evidence_quote: Long battery life, Waterproofing and shockproofing, SD card slots and headphone jacks, Decent mic ... I didn't care about: best camera ... AI ... Cloud storage

claims.claim_text: Best camera, AI enhancements, and cloud storage were explicitly not wanted.
claims.evidence_quote: Having the best camera ... AI enhancements ... unnecessary ... Cloud storage ... preferred offline independence
claims.reasoning: All three rejects are explicitly stated.

claims.claim_text: Apple and Google deliberately limit offline use to push cloud services.
claims.evidence_quote: Companies like Apple and Google deliberately limited options for offline use ... to push cloud services
claims.reasoning: Attribution and motive match directly.

claims.claim_text: Ulefone rugged phones solved real problems at a tenth of flagship prices.
claims.evidence_quote: focused on solving real problems ... cost about 1/10th the price of flagship devices
claims.reasoning: Problem-solving focus and the 1/10th price ratio are exact.

claims.claim_text: Ulefone offered waterproofing, shock/dust proofing, dual SIM, SD, jack, and week-long battery.
claims.evidence_quote: Waterproof, shockproof, and dustproof ... Dual SIM, SD card slots, headphone jacks ... One model lasted an entire week
claims.reasoning: Feature list matches; the week-long figure is correctly scoped by the source to one model and the loglog lists it among loved features without falsifying.

claims.claim_text: The phones survived drops and swimming; a deep lake dive only made the current one act up.
claims.evidence_quote: dropped them countless times, taken them swimming ... dived a bit too deep ... started acting up, it still works

claims.reasoning: Thesis and big-vs-small contrast are directly stated.
